title: DotAgents MCP Configuration
description: Schema for DotAgents MCP server configuration file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor tooling.

servers.description: Map of server names to their configuration.

^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$.description: Configuration for a single MCP server.

type.description: Type of the server connection. http represents current MCP Streamable HTTP; sse represents legacy HTTP+SSE.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server (required if type = 'http' or type = 'sse').

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with remote MCP requests.

args.description: Arguments for stdio command (only for type = 'stdio').

cwd.description: Working directory for the stdio process.

env.description: Environment variables for the stdio process.

envFile.description: Path to environment file (only for type = 'stdio').

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled.

disabledTools.description: Generic list of tools disabled for this server.

enabledTools.description: Generic list of tools enabled for this server.

required.description: Whether this MCP server is required by providers that support required servers.

startupTimeoutSec.description: Startup timeout in seconds for providers that support startup timeouts.

toolTimeoutSec.description: Tool invocation timeout in seconds for providers that support tool timeouts.

bearerTokenEnvVar.description: Environment variable name containing a bearer token for providers that support this setting.

envVars.description: Environment variable names that providers should expose to this server.

alwaysAllow.description: Tools auto-approved for providers that support always-allow lists.

autoConnect.description: Whether providers that support connection behavior should auto-connect this server.
